referenceBasis.qualification: Fresh recovery director independently personally reviewed all sixteen current phone originals. findingsResolved: Current originals show a substantial reflective metal entrance with sharper upper shoulders, a broad grounded curved lower casting, dark grooves and multiple thick brilliant saturated light rails rather than a thin uniform loop.

Continuous faceted jewel faces fill the native CTA at both phone widths, retaining rich colour, visible reflective planes and uninterrupted beveled endcaps without the recorded 430px letterbox gutters or extra exposed tray.
NFL sapphire, fixed NBA blue-left/red-right, NRL emerald and UFC ruby remain distinct through housing, gemstone and glow; all four sport selectors retain their own illuminated hue while inactive.
Current UFC selector and main mark retain vivid ruby-red colour; league marks, preserved brand and venue interiors remain sharp and proportionate.

The compact reflective floor maintains dense entrance-to-CTA hierarchy and leaves sport selectors and bottom navigation visible in the native phone composition; labels remain legible and control corners remain unclipped.
NFL displays Enter, other sports display their Coming soon states, and UFC uses Fighters; complete browser reports separately verify the native interactions and motion behavior.

Full-image preview omissions of inactive navigation were resolved as a viewer artifact by independent OCR of exact native original pixels in both engines and existing exact Chrome navigation crops; no application change was made.
